description: Evaluation mode for developers: returns LendMail's stored, hand-checked analysis_v1 for one of its public sample letters (apex-verified: Apex Credit, a fictional lender, with a verified LendMail Advisors mark; unmarked-demo: a demo credit card mailer with no mark). No upload and no model call. Call with no sample_id to list the samples. Output follows https://www.lendmail.fit/schemas/analysis-v1.json; docs at https://www.lendmail.fit/developers.

sample_id.description: Sample letter id: apex-verified or unmarked-demo. Omit to list the samples.

name: run_sample_analysis
title: Run sample analysis (evaluation mode)
